datenschutz.title: Privacy
datenschutz.subtitle: Information on the processing of personal data
datenschutz.intro: This privacy notice explains which personal data is processed when you use Chat Sribiddi.
datenschutz.dataBody: When the website is accessed, technically required connection data is processed, in particular IP address, timestamps, browser information and security-related log data. When you sign in with Google, the account information provided by Google is processed insofar as it is required for sign-in and your user account.
datenschutz.chatBody: When you use the service, your inputs, uploaded content, model selection, generated responses and any stored provider credentials are processed. Credentials are stored in encrypted form. Content from the chat feature is transmitted to the AI provider you have selected, insofar as this is necessary to process your request.
datenschutz.purposeBody: Processing is carried out to provide the service and authentication (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR) and to ensure secure and stable operation (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).
datenschutz.recipientsBody: Recipients of the data are technical service providers for hosting and authentication as well as the AI providers you have selected. Data is only forwarded insofar as it is necessary for the operation of Chat Sribiddi.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Personal data is only retained for as long as necessary for the stated purposes or as long as legal retention obligations apply. Chat content and stored provider credentials remain saved until they are removed via the settings page or, when your account is deleted, removed together with the associated chat data.
datenschutz.rightsBody: You have the right to information, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
datenschutz.providerKeysBody: [TODO: Legal text — Signed-in users may connect credentials for external AI providers. Credentials are encrypted and used only to send requests to the selected provider on behalf of the user.]

Cookies and similar technologies are used to deliver personalised or non-personalised ads. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (consent via the cookie banner). Further information at https://policies.google.com/privacy.]
datenschutz.aiProvidersBody: [TODO: Legal text — To provide the chat feature, your inputs are transmitted to the AI provider you have selected: OpenRouter Inc. Depending on the provider, data may be transferred to third countries (in particular the USA) on the basis of EU standard contractual clauses and, where applicable, additional safeguards. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (performance of contract).]
